channel.title: The Argo: the house of 0x8865de06
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Peisnikos #6394 Siren-deaf was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares
item.description: Peisnikos #6394 Siren-deaf was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: The fire under Kallides Kratgenides ~1231 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar
item.description: The fire under Kallides Kratgenides ~1231 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.title: Broken, not dead: Kratgenes #6533 (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). The Reaper
item.description: Broken, not dead: Kratgenes #6533 (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.
